semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Koiwai specializes in large-scale thin-walled castings that can be applied to semiconductor manufacturing equipment, leveraging their unique casting technology.
summary: Koiwai develops and manufactures large-scale thin-walled castings using advanced 3D sand mold printing technology, aimed at high-strength lightweight applications in semiconductor manufacturing. Their patented technologies enhance the precision and performance of components used in the semiconductor industry.
